paper_title: Prometheus 2 An Open Source Language Model Specialized in Evaluating   Other Language Models
caption: When merging models, the influence of relative evaluation on absolute evaluation is greater than the influence of absolute evaluation on relative evaluation. Performance of Direct Assessment (colored in green) and Pairwise Ranking (colored in blue) when altering the value to merge evaluator LMs trained on different formats.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of Direct Assessment Correlation and Pairwise Ranking Accuracy as the merging ratio between Direct Assessment and Pairwise Ranking changes. The x-axis is labeled "(Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking) Merging Ratio" with a linear scale, ranging from 1:9 to 9:1, with tick labels at each ratio interval. The left y-axis is labeled "Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.500 to 0.675, and tick labels at intervals of 0.025. The right y-axis is labeled "Pairwise Ranking Agreement Accuracy" with a linear scale, ranging from 50 to 80, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The green line, representing Direct Assessment Correlation, starts at approximately 0.504 at a merging ratio of 1:9, increases to a peak of around 0.675 at 5:5, and then decreases to about 0.625 at 9:1. The blue line, representing Pairwise Ranking Accuracy, begins at around 79 at 1:9, remains relatively stable until 5:5, and then declines to approximately 50 at 9:1. The black line, representing Average Performance, starts at about 0.575 at 1:9, rises to around 0.625 at 5:5, and then decreases to approximately 0.525 at 9:1.
